reasoning: Shows a flame with an exclamation mark, clearly communicating fire alarm, fire safety/hazard, heating/gas fault, or wildfire alert. It fits a concrete set of home safety, boiler maintenance, outdoor burn-ban, and incident-response tasks, though it must not be misused as a generic 'urgent task' property icon.
